sections.title: Scaling Machine Intelligence via Protocol Incentives
sections.body: Bittensor is a peer-to-peer intelligence market that rewards miners for providing valuable machine learning models. Kenya AI Compute facilitates this by offering specialized node-hosting services for Bittensor miners and validators. The protocol requires high-uptime GPU resources to participate in competitive subnets. Our $0.04/kWh energy advantage allows Bittensor miners operating in our facility to achieve significantly higher net margins compared to those using standard cloud services or residential power. We offer managed Bittensor setups, where our technical team handles the hardware maintenance and network optimization, while you focus on the model performance and subnet strategy. This partnership turns our Kenyan site into a critical node in the global brain that Bittensor is building.
